name: exam-gate
description: Require a checklist to pass before Claude declares a task complete. Failed checks send it back to work, while repeated failures return control to you.
sourceDescription: Before Claude calls a task done, run your checklist. Fail means Claude is sent back to fix it; repeated failure trips a breaker and hands control back to you.
author: swei99386-alt

category.label: Testing Mods
category.basis: Runs acceptance checks and retries failed work before completion.
